purpose: Support logical AIs with two coordinated internal cores without double-counting identity, execution, memory or evidence.
rules: A dual-core AI remains one logical AI unless an explicit registry says otherwise.
Two cores are not two independent evidence lines by default.
Each core execution requires its own worker/model/run/log/artifact/receipt/provenance before it can be called executed.
Shared model, data, source, method or memory dependencies must be declared.
Core disagreement must enter CONTRADICTION_BANK rather than be hidden by averaging.
A6_MEMORY_KEEPER remains the default persistent writer.
No dual-core assignment may be claimed without a repository manifest and verification.
